title: Variables and data types: what kind of thing is each column?

objectives.statement: Classify each recorded column of a supplied study file as nominal, ordinal, discrete quantitative, or continuous quantitative, and justify the classification from how the values were produced rather than from how they are stored.
Select the summaries and displays a column's level of measurement supports, and explain why an unsupported summary reports the coding scheme rather than the people measured.
Decide from a study description whether two sets of values are paired or independent, and state what that structure settles about the comparison that follows.
